prefix_summary: AC-345 characterisation, D7 two-commit shape. Commit 1 (9f8a838, tests only, retrieve.py untouched -- the pre-#44 tree) adds test_prefix_baseline_starves_active_hits and test_topup_recovers_active_hits with no xfail markers: on that tree AC-345 (starvation) is GREEN and AC-346 (recovery) is RED -- a candidate_k=15 single-layer (semantic) corpus of 15 deprecated rows (tf=6, no padding) strictly outranking one active target (tf=1, 16 padding tokens) under recall_active_only=True (production parity, config.py's default) causes a plain k=candidate_k bm25_search fetch to return the 15 deprecated rows exclusively; the active target never reaches result.records. Commit 2 (fb28c4f) lands the retrieve.py caller-side status-blind top-up AND the @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason="pre-#44 starvation characterisation; XPASS = starvation regression (#44)") marker on AC-345's node in the SAME commit: post-fix AC-345 reports XFAIL (not PASS, not FAIL) because the top-up now recovers the target, so the node's own body assertion (target NOT in retrieved) fails as expected under the strict marker; AC-346 reports PASS on the identical corpus.
